cues: Make the body denser, and it sinks lower.
Ice in sea water has a density ratio of about zero point eight nine, so almost nine tenths of an iceberg hides below the surface.
text: Make the body denser, and it sinks lower. Lighter, and it rides higher. Ice in sea water has a density ratio of about zero point eight nine, so almost nine tenths of an iceberg hides below the surface.
